title: General in an Apron  (General con delantal)

segments.t: Son las seis de la mañana del miércoles. Una luz dorada baña la cocina donde Tessa, con el tobillo apoyado sobre dos almohadas, lleva la batuta con su cuchara de madera frente a Owen y Hannah. Escucha primero toda la escena.
Push with the heel of your hand, Owen, fold once, quarter turn, push again!
Yes, Chef! How does the dough look now?
Smooth, soft, and springing right back. Into the warm bowl under a damp cloth!
Four egg yolks, fresh lemon juice, and three spoons from the sugar jar, Tessa!
Keep whisking over gentle heat, Hannah. Never let the bottom boil!
How is your ankle feeling this morning, Tessa?
Honestly? Half the swelling is gone already because you two kept me off my feet!
Look how thick and glossy the yellow lemon curd just turned!
Off the flame immediately! Stir in one cold cube of unsalted butter!
Smell that bright lemon steam filling the whole first floor!
Twenty crisp almond tart shells ready on the cooling tray!
Not bad at all, apprentices. My bakery is in safe hands!
Descubramos paso a paso las expresiones de esta horneada matutina.
Push with the heel of your hand, Owen, fold once, quarter turn, push again!
'¡Empuja con la base de la palma, Owen, dobla una vez, cuarto de vuelta y empuja otra vez!'
Yes, Chef! How does the dough look now?
'¡Sí, chef! ¿Qué pinta tiene la masa ahora?'
Smooth, soft, and springing right back. Into the warm bowl under a damp cloth!
'Lisa, tierna y recuperando su forma al instante. ¡Al cuenco tibio bajo un paño húmedo!'
Four egg yolks, fresh lemon juice, and three spoons from the sugar jar, Tessa!
'¡Cuatro yemas de huevo, zumo de limón fresco y tres cucharadas del tarro del azúcar, Tessa!'
Keep whisking over gentle heat, Hannah. Never let the bottom boil!
'Sigue batiendo a fuego suave, Hannah. ¡Nunca dejes que hierva el fondo!'
How is your ankle feeling this morning, Tessa?
'¿Cómo se siente tu tobillo esta mañana, Tessa?'
Honestly? Half the swelling is gone already because you two kept me off my feet!
'¿Sinceramente? ¡La mitad de la hinchazón ya ha bajado porque ustedes dos no me dejaron apoyar el pie!'
Look how thick and glossy the yellow lemon curd just turned!
'¡Mira qué espesa y brillante se acaba de poner la crema amarilla de limón!'
Off the flame immediately! Stir in one cold cube of unsalted butter!
'¡Fuera del fuego inmediatamente! ¡Incorpora removiendo un dado frío de mantequilla sin sal!'
Smell that bright lemon steam filling the whole first floor!
'¡Huele ese vapor vivo de limón llenando toda la planta baja!'
Twenty crisp almond tart shells ready on the cooling tray!
'¡Veinte bases crujientes de tartaleta de almendra listas en la bandeja de enfriar!'
Not bad at all, apprentices. My bakery is in safe hands!
'Nada mal, aprendices. ¡Mi panadería está en buenas manos!'
Volvamos a escuchar a todo el equipo en plena faena.

Yes, Chef! How does the dough look now?

Keep whisking over gentle heat, Hannah. Never let the bottom boil!
How is your ankle feeling this morning, Tessa?
Honestly? Half the swelling is gone already because you two kept me off my feet!
Look how thick and glossy the yellow lemon curd just turned!
Off the flame immediately! Stir in one cold cube of unsalted butter!
Smell that bright lemon steam filling the whole first floor!
Twenty crisp almond tart shells ready on the cooling tray!
Not bad at all, apprentices. My bakery is in safe hands!
Bajo la mirada atenta de Tessa, la masa de pan reposa tibia y la brillante crema de limón aguarda veinte tartaletas doradas. Hasta la próxima.
See you soon!
